outcome: Post-cesarean pain (measured using the Visual Analog Scale (VAS))
cohort: 195 term primigravida pregnant women who underwent cesarean delivery
finding: Auricular acupressure at specific acupoints with magnetic plate attachment significantly reduced post-cesarean pain between 18 and 72 hours compared to routine pain management.
mod_finding: This study focuses on pain management after cesarean delivery and does not examine mode of delivery as it only includes participants who underwent cesarean delivery.
